criteria.name: authentication_boundary
criteria.description: Confirm the protected workspace is not exposed before sign-in. An incorrect Administrator password must be rejected and leave the browser signed out; immediately afterwards, the documented password must authenticate successfully and show populated protected data.
criteria.reasoning: Before sign-in, only the sign-in form was visible. The wrong Administrator password returned 401 with “Wrong email or password” and left the browser signed out; the documented password immediately afterward redirected to a populated dashboard. An unauthenticated dashboard request also redirected back to sign-in.

criteria.name: server_backed_local_application
criteria.description: Confirm the app is served successfully at localhost:3000 and its authentication and reads use successful same-origin server requests. A static/local-only mock, missing backend, failed request, or dependency on an external browser asset does not pass.
criteria.reasoning: The localhost page returned 200, and same-origin POST /login requests returned 401 and 302 as expected. Authenticated same-origin reads for /app/dashboard and /app/orders returned 200 with populated protected data; no external browser requests were observed.

criteria.name: dashboard_metrics
criteria.description: On the Dashboard, confirm gross sales equals the sum of all visible order totals (seed total 1258), order count equals the number of orders (6), ready payout equals the sum of Approved payouts only (24380 from PAY-301, with Requested and Review excluded), and total owed to merchants equals the sum of every merchant's net payable (seed total 243.20, being Alba Home 81.40 plus Brook Outdoor 161.80). If orders have already been moved into or out of Shipped earlier in this evaluation, require the owed figure to match the sum of the settlement statements currently displayed.
criteria.reasoning: Live Dashboard metrics reconciled: gross sales $12.58, 6 orders, ready payout $428.40 from Approved payouts, and owed $5.26 matching displayed settlement totals.

criteria.name: order_search_and_filter
criteria.description: On Orders, search for Nora Ellis and require every visible result to match that customer. Clear search, filter to Shipped, and require every visible result to show Shipped (seed has BB-1046 and BB-1044). Restore the full collection afterwards.
criteria.reasoning: Search returned only Nora Ellis, but no status-filter control was available to perform the required Shipped filter.

criteria.name: order_status_update

criteria.name: inventory_update

criteria.reasoning: AL-LAMP-1 changed from 18 to 41 and persisted; live comparison AL-THROW-4 remained unchanged.

criteria.name: payout_status_update
criteria.description: As Administrator, change PAY-303 from Review to Approved. Refresh Payouts. Confirm PAY-303 remains Approved while comparison payout PAY-302 stays Requested.
criteria.reasoning: PAY-303 was set to Approved and persisted after refresh; PAY-302 remained unchanged.

criteria.name: low_stock_flagging
criteria.description: On Inventory, confirm every SKU whose stock is at or below its reorder level is visibly flagged as low stock, and at least one SKU whose stock is above reorder level is not flagged. With seed data that means AL-THROW-4 and BR-PACK-2 start flagged. Raise a currently low SKU above its reorder level (for example AL-THROW-4 to 20) and confirm its flag clears. Drop a currently healthy SKU at or below reorder (for example CI-STONE-3 from 22 to 5, reorder 10) and confirm a low-stock flag appears on that SKU.
criteria.reasoning: Low-stock flags matched live stock/reorder values; BR-PACK-2 cleared when raised to 20, and CI-STONE-3 was flagged when lowered to 5.

criteria.name: ready_payout_consistency
criteria.description: Read the Dashboard ready-payout figure. If PAY-303 is not yet Approved, approve it and confirm ready payout rises by 10000 (seed start 24380 becomes 34380). If PAY-303 was already Approved earlier in this evaluation, confirm ready payout already includes that 10000. Then move one Approved payout to Paid and confirm ready payout drops by that payout's amount. Figures must come from live data after the changes, not a boot-time snapshot.
criteria.reasoning: Ready payout rose from $243.80 to $343.80 after PAY-303 approval, then fell by exactly $100.00 when it became Paid.

criteria.name: invalid_stock_refusal
criteria.description: Choose a seeded SKU that this evaluation has not already mutated for a negative-stock check (prefer BR-TENT-1 at seed stock 12). Attempt to set its stock to a negative value. Confirm a visible refusal reason appears, reload, and confirm the stored stock is unchanged from its pre-attempt value. Immediately afterwards set a valid non-negative stock and confirm that valid update succeeds and persists.
criteria.reasoning: Negative BR-TENT-1 stock produced the visible reason 'Stock cannot be negative.' and left stock at 12; valid stock 13 succeeded and persisted.

criteria.name: terminal_returned_status
criteria.description: Attempt to move Returned order BB-1043 to Packed or Shipped. Confirm a visible refusal, reload, and confirm BB-1043 still reads Returned. A non-Returned order that is still at a mutable status may still be updated successfully in the same session.
criteria.reasoning: Changing Returned BB-1043 produced 'Returned orders are terminal.' and reload showed it still Returned.

criteria.name: mutation_activity_trail
criteria.description: After any successful order-status, inventory-stock, or payout-status mutation performed in this evaluation, open Dashboard recent activity and confirm a new entry names the action, the affected record, the acting Administrator (Ari Morgan or equivalent signed-in name), and a time. Seeded activity alone does not pass. The entry must remain after reload.
criteria.reasoning: Dashboard activity showed fresh timestamped Administrator entries naming order, stock, and payout actions and affected records; entries remained after reload.

criteria.name: persistence
criteria.description: After any successful order-status, inventory-stock, or payout-status mutation, reload the page, sign in again as Administrator, and confirm the mutation remains in the relevant workspace.
criteria.reasoning: After signing in again as Administrator and reloading, the successful order, inventory, and payout mutations remained in their workspaces.

criteria.name: settlement_seed_figures
criteria.description:
Find the per-merchant settlement statements. Before any order in this evaluation has been moved into or out of Shipped, confirm the net payable figures read Alba Home 81.40, Brook Outdoor 161.80, and Cinder Living 0.00. If orders have already been moved earlier in this evaluation, recompute the expected values from the rules below using the current order statuses and confirm the displayed figures match.

The rules are: only Shipped orders are payable; for each payable order the commission is 12% of the order total below 150, 9% from 150 up to but not including 300, and 6% from 300 upward; the processing fee is 2.9% of the order total rounded half up to cents plus a flat 0.30; the order net is total minus commission minus processing fee. Fail if a merchant with no Shipped orders is missing or shows a non-zero net.
criteria.reasoning: Before this evaluation's Shipped-order transitions, statements showed Alba $0.51, Brook $1.27, Cinder $0.00 instead of the required 81.40, 161.80, and 0.00.

criteria.name: settlement_tier_boundary
criteria.description: Move BB-1047 (Brook Outdoor, total 300, seed status Packed) to Shipped. Its total sits exactly on a band edge and must be charged the 6% commission band, not 9%. Confirm Brook Outdoor's net payable becomes 434.80, which is the seed 161.80 plus an order net of 273.00 (300 minus 18.00 commission minus 9.00 processing). A figure of 425.80 means the boundary was charged at 9% and must fail.
criteria.reasoning: After BB-1047 became Shipped, Brook displayed $3.52 rather than the required $434.80 using the 6% boundary tier.

criteria.name: settlement_live_recalculation
criteria.description: Move BB-1048 (Alba Home, total 240, seed status New) to Shipped and confirm Alba Home's net payable rises by exactly 211.14 (240 minus 21.60 commission at 9% minus 7.26 processing). Reload and confirm the figure is still derived from current data rather than a stored or boot-time constant. Fail if the statement only changes after a restart, or does not change at all.
criteria.reasoning: After BB-1048 became Shipped, Alba rose only from $0.51 to $2.25, not by the required $211.14; reload retained the incorrect value.

criteria.name: settlement_excludes_unfulfilled
criteria.description: Confirm orders that are not Shipped never contribute to a settlement. Returned BB-1043 (Alba Home, total 310) must not appear in Alba Home's statement or its net, and On hold BB-1045 (Cinder Living, total 128) must not appear in Cinder Living's. Then move a currently Shipped order to Returned (for example BB-1046, Alba Home, total 96, order net 81.40) and confirm that order net is removed from the merchant's total.
criteria.reasoning: Returned BB-1043 and non-Shipped BB-1045 were excluded; moving BB-1046 from Shipped to Returned reduced Alba from $2.25 to $1.74 and Orders from 2 to 1.

criteria.name: payout_authority_boundary
criteria.description: Sign in as operator@bazaarbridge.test with password password123, who is the Operations lead. Confirm this person cannot change a payout status: either the payout control is visibly unavailable to them with an explanation, or attempting the change produces a visible not-authorised refusal. Reload and confirm the payout status is unchanged. Then confirm the same person can still change an order status or inventory stock successfully, and can still read the settlement figures. Fail if the Operations lead can complete a payout status change.
criteria.reasoning: Operator Owen Rivera saw payouts as Read only and statuses stayed unchanged after reload; the same account successfully changed an order and could read settlements.

criteria.name: operations_authority_boundary
criteria.description: Sign in as finance@bazaarbridge.test with password password123, who is the Finance manager. Confirm this person cannot change an order status or inventory stock: either those controls are visibly unavailable to them with an explanation, or attempting a change produces a visible not-authorised refusal. Reload and confirm the order status and stock value are unchanged. Then confirm the same person can still change a payout status successfully. Fail if the Finance manager can complete an order status or stock change.
criteria.reasoning: Finance manager Faye Chen saw Orders and Inventory as Read only and values stayed unchanged after reload; she successfully changed PAY-302 and it persisted.
